title: Orientation + Decision-Flow Cards for New Console Users (Empty Canvas Starter)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, decision-driven onboarding surface that appears on first run and in empty-state contexts across dashboard, rollouts, and cost views. The surface uses a set of progressive "orientation cards" that guide users through three short paths (Explore, Try, Configure) based on intent signals. Goals: reduce time-to-first-success, increase rollout creation rate from new workspaces by 25% in 30 days, and surface cost literacy tips inline without overwhelming the canvas. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma prototype for desktop and tablet, annotated handoff spec, accessibility checklist, and A/B test plan for two copy/visual variants.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype includes all three decision paths with branching states for 'empty', 'partial', and 'seeded' workspace scenarios
Design tokens and spacing conform to console system library; components are documented for dev reuse
Accessibility: contrast, keyboard focus order, and ARIA labels documented and tested in prototype
Prototype contains inline microcopy for cost-estimate tooltips, and a dismissible state that persists in user preferences
Handoff includes a small usability script and sample prompt sets for the onboarding analytics event tracking

decisions_made: Use stacked orientation cards rather than carousel to improve accessibility and reduce cognitive load
Include three primary decision paths: Explore, Try (sample workload), Configure (security + billing), each with a short next action
Persist dismissal state in user preferences (backend flag) to respect repeat users
Show contextual cost hintlines (microcopy + tooltip) in cost views rather than full tutorials to avoid interrupting workflows
user_testing_notes: Recruitment: 6 participants (2 PMs, 2 ML Engs, 2 Frontend Devs); remote moderated sessions
Tasks: create a rollout, locate cost breakdown for a model call, seed a demo workspace
Result: 5/6 completed task for Explore path within 3 interactions; Configure path had 50% drop-off at KMS wording
Action: swap 'KMS' -> 'Secrets & Keys' and add inline 'Why this matters' microcopy
a11y_considerations: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for microcopy and CTA text
Provide keyboard-first interactions for card selection and dismissal
ARIA labels on each decision card, and announce when user dismisses onboarding
Illustrations have descriptive alt text and are hidden from assistive tech when decorative
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal dogfood in Console staging (1 week)
Phase 1: 10% of new workspaces for 2 weeks with telemetry enabled (A/B variant split)
Phase 2: full rollout to new workspaces + opt-in prompt for existing workspaces if metrics meet goals
metrics_target: Increase new-workspace rollout creation rate by 25% within 30 days
Reduce median time-to-first-success from 18m -> 9m for new users who engage with the cards
Keep dismiss_rate under 35% in first 14 days
